Emergency authority: Delegated senior IT/security decision-maker if the Incident Response Lead is unavailable
Technical executor: Delegated triage role and available IT/security support
Required consultation: Security Analyst and IT Operations Lead
Escalation: Senior Management if material or Critical
Documentation requirement: Record evidence basis incident ID severity uncertainty owner delegation and next review

Emergency authority: Deputy or delegated incident director recorded by the authorised authority
Technical executor: Incident Response Lead coordinates available functions
Required consultation: IT Operations Security Analyst Business Service Owner BCC and advisers as needed
Escalation: Senior Management for Critical or extraordinary resource activation
Documentation requirement: Record activation scope resources channel and review point

Emergency authority: Management may direct a higher tier or a recorded deputy may act
Technical executor: Incident Response Lead coordinates; analysts and owners provide inputs
Required consultation: Security Analyst IT Operations Business Service Owner and BCC
Escalation: Senior Management or Executive Sponsor for Critical
Documentation requirement: Record evidence impact uncertainty authority notification and reassessment basis

Emergency authority: IT Operations Lead or formally delegated senior IT/security authority only under the emergency condition
Technical executor: Authorised IT Operations operator within approved scope
Required consultation: IT Operations Lead Security Analyst and Business Service Owner where material effects exist
Escalation: Management for material consequences or risk acceptance
Documentation requirement: Record scope expected effect evidence preservation business effect approval and review time

Emergency authority: IT Operations Lead or formally delegated senior IT/security authority when the Incident Response Lead cannot be reached promptly and delay may materially worsen harm
Technical executor: Authorised operator within the minimum approved scope
Required consultation: Security Analyst IT Operations Lead Business Service Owner and BCC as relevant
Escalation: Notify Incident Response Lead or deputy and Management; retrospective management review for material effects
Documentation requirement: Record urgency authority scope evidence loss notification business impact and retrospective review deadline

Normal authority: Incident Response Lead within approved delegated authority
Emergency authority: Emergency authority may approve only proportionate protective action under the emergency procedure and must obtain retrospective review
Technical executor: Relevant authorised operator within approved deviation
Required consultation: Technical business and security advisers as relevant
Escalation: Senior Management if impact becomes material or controls are materially weakened
Documentation requirement: Record limited impact rationale compensating control duration authority and review condition

Normal authority: Senior Management or designated Executive Sponsor
Emergency authority: Emergency protective action may proceed only to reduce immediate harm; management review is mandatory
Required consultation: Technical Business Service Owner Security Analyst and Privacy/Legal advisers as relevant
Escalation: Executive Sponsor and affected management authority
Documentation requirement: Record institutional risk acceptance scope duration compensating controls consultation and review deadline

Emergency authority: IT Operations Lead or formally delegated senior IT/security authority for minimum protective action only under the emergency procedure
Technical executor: Delegate or assigned operator within recorded scope
Required consultation: Receiving role and technical business and security advisers as relevant
Escalation: Notify Incident Response Lead or deputy and Management for material effects; no onward delegation unless expressly permitted
Documentation requirement: Record recipient or deputy delegated scope start time WAT expiry or review time WAT restrictions approval reference and revocation conditions

Decision/activity: Appointment of incident leadership or continuity deputy
Emergency authority: Acting appointment by a management-designated authority; no self-appointment by the Incident Response Lead or Business Continuity Coordinator
Technical executor: Appointed incident director or BCC deputy performs assigned coordination; no technical execution authority is implied
Required consultation: Incident Response Lead IT Operations Lead Business Service Owner and BCC or Academic Operations as relevant
Escalation: Notify affected teams and Management; review if scope or authority changes
Documentation requirement: Record appointment authority appointed role scope effective time WAT expiry or review time WAT and communication to affected teams

Normal authority: Senior Management retains authority for material activation and institutional risk acceptance
Emergency authority: Management-designated deputy or BCC may coordinate only within written delegation; material decisions remain with Management
Technical executor: Business Continuity Coordinator coordinates authorised arrangements
Required consultation: Incident Response Lead Business Service Owner Academic Operations and IT Operations Lead
Escalation: Senior Management for material deviation extraordinary resources or Critical decisions
Documentation requirement: Record trigger authority delegation continuity option security restrictions approval and review condition

Normal authority: Relevant Academic or Business Service Owner within approved parameters
Emergency authority: Senior Management approves material deviation or institutional risk acceptance; BCC may coordinate predefined low-risk preparation
Technical executor: BCC coordinates; IT Operations executes approved technical prerequisites
Required consultation: Incident Response Lead Security Analyst BCC Academic Operations and Management as relevant
Escalation: Management if the option changes material risk or approved parameters
Documentation requirement: Record learner impact technical prerequisites security assumptions approval communications and review condition

Normal authority: IT Operations Lead for approved technical work with required security and business gates
Emergency authority: Senior Management approves High/Critical material restoration risk; emergency action does not authorise unsafe restoration
Required consultation: Security Analyst for validation and Business Service Owner for service readiness
Escalation: Senior Management for High/Critical or material risk acceptance
Documentation requirement: Record restoration scope security validation data-integrity checks approval and execution status

Normal authority: Business Service Owner after security integrity and technical gates
Emergency authority: Senior Management accepts material continuity risk or deviation
Technical executor: Service owner and management confirm business acceptance
Required consultation: Incident Response Lead Security Analyst IT Operations Lead Academic Operations and BCC as relevant
Escalation: Senior Management for material or Critical service return
Documentation requirement: Record business readiness learner impact conditions owner approval and review

Normal authority: Incident Response Lead with required management and Business Service Owner acceptance
Emergency authority: Designated deputy or incident director if formally appointed; Management approval remains required where applicable
Technical executor: Incident Response Lead coordinates record completion and follow-up owners
Required consultation: Security IT Business Service Owner Privacy/Legal Communications and BCC as relevant
Escalation: Senior Management for unresolved material risk or Critical closure
Documentation requirement: Record closure authority unresolved risks communications follow-up owners and review outcome
